scope: official VIRAT Ground 2.0 boxes; test samples selected/reviewed but neither imported nor evaluated

sampling.algorithm: thin each track by zero-based frame distance, evenly cap per track, then evenly cap per scene/label
sampling.reason: avoid adjacent frames and long/static tracks overwhelming the small pilot

limitations: human review of every contact sheet remains required
VIRAT usage-agreement acceptance receipt remains pending user confirmation
reviewed distant pedestrians can be only 2-6 pixels wide in the 256x144 analysis image, which is a model-capability limit
official boxes test classification input only; CCL candidate quality is a separate experiment
test split has selection metadata/contact sheets only and is absent from road_roi_dataset
binary classifier has no invalid-candidate rejection path
dataset_boundary: This run wrote into road_roi_dataset, which also contains CDnet and UA-DETRAC-mirror pilots. Use road_roi_dataset_virat and virat_only_import instead.
